meta.githubCommitMessage:
fix: keep CQC touch controls clear of the mobile PWA banner

Hide the parent status banner while CQC is active at widths of 980 px or less. Its state and the actions in other modules remain available. Preserve the closed production proofs, old parent sources and failed UI harness attempts.

Validation: TypeScript lint and build mode; real offline/online navigation at 390, 980 and 981 px; twelve accessible buttons and real movement, fire and reload. Native browser (273), HTTP (1018) and stage (81) checks passed in production on parent 26c5a845. All 334 native source files and the CQC runtime manifest remain byte unchanged.
